headline: Executive order sets the order of officials who would lead the Department of Health and Human Services if top leaders are unavailable.
what_it_does: This order lists which officials would act as Secretary of Health and Human Services if the Secretary and other top leaders die, resign, or cannot do the job. It sets a chain of command so the department can keep working without a gap in leadership. No summary was provided, so the specific positions named in the list are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Senior officials at the Department of Health and Human Services
who_it_affects.how: Certain officials are placed in a set order to temporarily take over the Secretary's duties if needed.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 15, 2008; specific effective date not stated in the source material.
